name: Mikka

facts.text: Living Server lore: Mikka as the map-reader of Caille who holds the other half of every secret map in Bri Leith.

story:
Caille is a small place on the Bri Leith road, a hermit's hut and a training yard where a blademaster teaches the young, and a stone bench under an elm where Mikka sits. The valley folk call Mikka the map-reader. Every secret map in the Valley of Bri Leith ends up in Caille sooner or later, because a map in two halves needs both halves read together, and Mikka is the one person in the valley who can read a half and say what the other half must say.

Nobody remembers when Mikka came to Caille. The Old Hermit in the hut says Mikka was on the bench when he arrived, and he arrived before the blademaster's grandfather. The valley children think Mikka is one of the Good Folk who forgot to go home. The druids of Bri Leith think Mikka is a lurikeen of the old mapmakers' families who drew the valley for the High Kings, when there were High Kings in Bri Leith, and who still remembers every road the valley had before the Veil wore thin and some of the roads went elsewhere.

The most famous map Mikka has read is the one Bran the Giant guards in the Cliffs of Moher, which Bran's Enchantress enchanted and which shows, the bards of Howth say, where Nuada's silver wrist was hidden when the king's hand was made. Young Hibernians bring Bran's half to Caille, having fought Bran for it, and Mikka reads it on the bench, and tells them what Chief Proinnsias of Howth needs to hear. The druids of Howth think the silver lies under the Silvermine, in the Unseelie's mine. Mikka has never said where. Mikka tells only Proinnsias, through the young who carry the word.

The valley folk also say that Mikka does not like to be interrupted, and that a stranger who comes to the bench without a map is a stranger who has come to Caille for the wrong reason.
legend: Mikka is a level 50 named at Caille in the Valley of Bri Leith (about 412k/538k), next to the Old Hermit and the Blademaster trainers. In the quest Secret of Nuada's Silver you give Bran the Giant's map piece to Mikka, but in this world's data Mikka is a plain spawn set aggressive (200), so how the hand-in works with that is untested here. As a fight: plain level 50, no script, 80-second respawn, easy for a 45-50 group. Mind the trainers next to the bench: the Blademaster and the Old Hermit stand within a few hundred units, so do not use area spells there. Fee lions and rage wolves wander the Caille road.

aggro: You have no map. Then why are you here?
Half a map is half a road. You have neither.

bookPage: From Derbáil of Ardee's list: Caille on the Bri Leith road, without a map. Mikka sits on the stone bench under the elm and reads the valley's secret maps, half at a time, and says what the other half must say. The Old Hermit says Mikka was on the bench before he came, and he came before the blademaster's grandfather. The young bring Bran the Giant's half of the Nuada map, and Mikka reads it and sends word to Chief Proinnsias of Howth. A stranger with no map has come to Caille for the wrong reason, my grandmother said.
